02 / Signal chain

What the screen does when your eyes are elsewhere.

01

Open-air board

Ten Solana names, ordered by boost spend, redrawn every minute with no login and no clicks.

02

Pinned frequency

Our own token claims row one the instant its address is announced. Until then a placeholder keeps the seat warm.

03

Quiet when blind

Should a feed drop, the last good figures stay put and dashes tell you something is off.

04

Twin receivers

Price data and launchpad details are requested side by side, so one slow line never stalls the other.

05

Reads like a scope

Figures count up and flash when they move. Motion is something you notice, not something you hunt for.

06

Built for thumbs

No control is smaller than forty-four pixels square, at any screen width, and motion switches off on request.

03 / Scope bench

A toy oscilloscope straight from the logo. Shape the trace, then see it settle through damped springs.

CH1 / TRACELOCKED

04 / Roadmap

Four stages, no calendar. Each opens when the one before it feels solid.

  1. Stage 01

    Carrier

    Site, brand and a live board go out the door. The pinned row waits behind a placeholder.

    ON AIR
  2. Stage 02

    Broadcast

    Contract address is published, our pinned row lights up and its pulse starts working.

  3. Stage 03

    Amplify

    Watchlists, deeper per-token views and alert hooks land on the desk.

  4. Stage 04

    Resonance

    Community tools and shared dashboards, shaped by whoever tunes in.
